content: Melkahka duwes Mwetin Wain

content.text: Kumwail rong pwe I pahn koulkihong kumwail koul pwoatet,
koul pwoat duwen en kompoakepahi men eh mwetin wain:
Mie en kompoakepahio eh mwetin wain ehu
E ahpw deipwelihada oh akerasang takai kan loale;
e ahpw padokediong loale tuhkehn wain me keieu kaselel.
E kauwada wasahn doulik ehu nanwerengeo,
oh weirada pwoahr ehu wasahn tiak kreip kan.
E ahpw kin kasikasik kreip kaselel sang ni tuhkehn wain kan,
ahpw ihte me e dolungada, kreip karer kei.

content: Eri, kompoakepahio ahpw mahsanih, “Kumwail mehn Serusalem oh Suda kan, kumwail kapwungala nanpwungen ngehi oh ei mwetin waino.
Mie mehkot me I sapwungala oh sohte wiahiong ei mwetin waino? Dahme kahrehda wah kan katingki oh sohte mwahu nin duwen me I kasikasik?
“Eri met, I pahn ndaiong kumwail dahme I pahn wiahiong ei mwetin wainet: I pahn kihsang kelepe; I pahn kauwehla kehl kan, pwe mahn lawalo kan en kangala oh tiakpeseng.
I pahn mweidala pwe en wiahla nanwel, sohte me pahn mwatih de apwalih; dihpw suwed oh takatek kan pahn kadirehla. I pahn koasoanehdi pwe depwek kan en dehr kalamwuriheki kisin dingiding en pihl kis.”

content.text: Israel iei sapwellimen KAUN-O, Wasa Lapalahpie, mwetin wain;
oh mehn Suda kan, iei sapwellime tuhkehn wain me e ketin padokedi.
E ketin kasikasik sang rehrail tiahk mwahu,
E ketin kasikasik sang rehrail wiewia pwung,
ahpw soh, pwe ngilen me re kapwalihalahr kan me peipeidohng.

content: Suwed en Aramas akan
Meid suwediong kumwail! Kumwail pwaindahr ihmw oh sahpw tohto pwehn kapatahiong mehkan me kumwail ahnekier. Kereniong meteikan pahn sohla wasahn ar kousoan, oh kumwail pahn kelehpwkilahr sahpwo.
I rongehr KAUN-O Wasa Lapalap eh mahsanih, “Ihmw pwukat koaros, me kalaimwun oh kaselel pahn tehnla oh ohla.
Mwetin wain kan nan sahpw eiker limau pahn kihda kalon en wain limaute. Kapakap en weren tuhke eisek pahn kapwarehda kapakap en kohn ehute.”
Meid suwediong kumwail! Kumwail kin pirida nimenseng oh tapihada nim sakau, oh kin sakasakau lel nipwong.
Kumwail kin kesekesengki arp oh damporin oh keseng pepeuk, oh niminim wain ni amwail kamadipw kan. Ahpw kumwail sohte wehwehki dahme KAUN-O ketin wiewia,
eri, kumwail pahn wisikasang nin duwen aramas selidi kei. Amwail kaun akan pahn mehkihla duhpek, oh aramas teikan pahn mehkihla ar men nimpil.
Wasahn me melahr akan men kadalleiraillahr, oh ewe sarapesengier. E pahn kadallehla soupeidi kan en Serusalem iangahki pokon en aramas me katakatairong.
Aramas koaros pahn namenekla, oh koaros me aklapalap pahn aktikitikla.
Ahpw KAUN-O, Wasa Lapalap, pahn ketin kasalehda sapwellime roson ni eh pahn ketin wia dahme pwung, oh e pahn ketin kasalehda sapwellime sarawi ni eh pahn ketin kadeikada sapwellime aramas akan.
Sihmpwul kan pahn kangkang reh kan oh sihpw pwulopwul kan pahn kangkang kisin tuhke kan nan mohn kahnimw kan.
Meid suwediong kumwail! Kumwail solahr kak saledeksang nan dipamwail kan.

Kumwail pahn nda, “KAUN-O en ketin mwadangodo oh wiahla dahme e ketin mahsanih me e pahn wia, pwe kitail en kak kilang. Koht sarawien Israel en ketin kapwaiada sapwellime koasoandi kan; kitail en kilang dahme e ketin kupwukupwure.”

Meid suwediong kumwail! Kumwail kin kahdaneki me suwed me mwahu oh me mwahu me suwed. Kumwail wekidohng rotorot ni marain oh marain ong ni rotorot. Kumwail wekidala mehkot katik pwehn memla oh mehkot mem pwehn katikala.
Meid suwediong kumwail! Kumwail kin kosekose me kumwail me loalokong, uhdahn koahiek.
Meid suwediong kumwail! Kumwail kin ndandkihla amwail kamam sakau! Me kommwad oh sohte kin masak mehkot ni ahnsoun doaloapene sakau kehlail kan!
Ahpw kisin pweipwei sapwung tikitik kis kin kahrehiong kumwail en kasaledekihala me dipadahr akan, oh sohte mweidohng me mwakelekel kan en ale pwuhng.

Eri met, duwen dihpw meng eh kin mwasikala nan kisiniei, iei duwen kalowemwail pahn mwoasoahngotala oh amwail mpwek pahn mengila oh sohrala, pwehki amwail soikalahr dahme KAUN-O Wasa Lapalap, Koht sarawien Israel, ketin padahkihong kitail.

KAUN-O ketin engieng pahn sapwellime aramas akan, oh ketin kapalahr lime pwehn kaloke irail. Nahna kan pahn rerada, oh paliweren me melahr akan pahn engiengpene nan ahl akan duwehte kihd. Engieng en KAUN-O sohte pahn tokedi, ahpw e pahn ketin kapahweite nin lime pwehn kalokaloke irail.
KAUN-O pahn ketin wiahda kilel ehu, kilel en eh pahn ketin malipe wehi doh ieu. E pahn ketin malipehki kapitie pwe re en patohdo sang ni imwin sampah. Oh iet irail samwodohr, wie pipihr kohdo.
Sohte emen rehrail me pwangada; sohte emen rehrail me dipekelekel. Re sohte mwahn lisoi de meirla. Sohte ehu kateng me mwer; sohte apwoat selin ar suht me ohla.

Neirail arep kan me keng, oh neirail kesik ketieu kan onopadahngehr en kesik. Pahnnehn neirail oahs akan kehlail duwehte takai, oh daiahn wararail werennansapw en mahwen kan marahra duwehte kisinieng.
Sounpei kan ngiringir duwehte laion kan me ahpwtehn kemehla mahn emen oh weuwalahng wasa me sohte emen kak en kihsang irail.
Ni rahno eh pahn leledo, re pahn ngiringir pohn Israel ni ngihl laud duwehte ngilen madau. Kitail kilang mahs wehiet! Rotorot oh kapwunod! Rotorot kadallelahr marain.
